description: This file defines a handler class for processing manual interest refund commands within a loan account context in the Fineract project. It implements the processing logic by delegating to a loan service method.

classes.name: ManualInterestRefundCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles manual interest refund commands for loans, identified by annotations for command type, and processes them transactionally.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles incoming JSON command to process manual interest refund by delegating to the LoanWritePlatformService.
